figmaSource.historicalNamedRevisionScope: F2 · Bookshelf · User Confirmed; retained as historical evidence only, not asserted as the live revision.

fontSource.title: Existing Songti SC title style retained without mutation
fontSource.bodyAndControl: Existing Inter style and repository CJK fallback retained; no download or substitution introduced

designDelta.oldValue: At the real 760x960 Tablet canvas, the shared runtime classified Bookshelf as expanded-width and inherited a centered 560px preview frame with a horizontal bottom navigation.
designDelta.newValue: Only the canonical Bookshelf route maps that 760x960 canvas to the attached Tablet master dimensions; Phone and all non-Bookshelf routes keep their existing responsive contracts.

designDelta.oldValue: The Tablet main-tab navigation remained in its Phone bottom-bar placement at the 760px source canvas.
designDelta.newValue: The existing Tablet shell rules apply only on Bookshelf: 82px left navigation, 18px gap, 58px items, and fixed vertical placement.

designDelta.oldValue: The attached Tablet Cover grid was constrained by the 560px preview frame rather than its 620px source content width.
designDelta.newValue: The existing three-column Cover grid now receives the 620px Tablet content width and preserves the Figma card geometry without changing BookCard markup or variants.

acceptance.viewportPolicy: Landscape aliases Tablet. No Compact, Fold, independent landscape master, Tablet List master, or state-specific layout was introduced.
geometryAndTypography: Headless Chrome at 390x844: the Bookshelf root and frame are exactly 390x844; the existing Phone content remains at x=1, y=107, w=388, h=736, with a 350px Cover grid.

Headless Chrome at 760x960: the Bookshelf root and frame are exactly 760x960; content is x=101, y=107, w=658, h=852; the left navigation is x=17, y=346, w=82, h=268; the Cover grid is x=120, y=271, w=620.
The verified Tablet geometry matches the current attached Figma master: a 620px three-column Cover shelf, a 100px Continue Reading card, and the fixed left main-tab navigation.
No font, cover asset, BookCard markup, shadow token, or component state was changed by this backport.
interaction: The existing Bookshelf reducer and direct controls were preserved without adding a Figma-unsourced action, state matrix, or overlay.
The current Figma component graph has Phone Cover and Tablet Cover cards only; this change deliberately does not introduce a Tablet List presentation.
Local Import Popup remains a separately completed VC3 scope and was not altered.

browserVerification.method: Headless Chrome direct DOM inspection and visual comparison at the two Figma source sizes
knownExternalConsoleArtifacts: one static File not found response on Phone
browserVerification.note: The artifacts are external/static-resource failures, not application exceptions, and are recorded rather than suppressed.

notImplemented: Bookshelf loading, empty, offline, error, search, filter, sort, and menu visual-state masters
pendingFigmaDesignBoundary.reason: The current Figma source read provides only the attached default Cover masters and visual microinteractions. A local backport must not create additional visual surfaces or alter reducer ownership without source nodes and user confirmation.
pendingFigmaDesignBoundary.rule: Do not add or restyle any of the listed states until Figma supplies the exact component/state source and the user confirms it.

evidenceCommitStrategy: This evidence-only file binds implementation commit 70f6c7d9dc8ca04f3c028f3bb88ce829e68ca7e7. It does not overwrite the historical F2 Design Delta or F0 Crosswalk.
boundary: This is a local-only static layout backport from the current Figma Bookshelf masters. It does not write Figma, alter preserved Figma pages/components/reactions, create detached frames, redefine UiEvent/reducer/route ownership, enter Motion Reference, change WebDAV/Search/Sync Backup/Source Management, or change any native client. The connector cannot expose the official current Figma revision after the live node reads, so no current revision is fabricated.
